messages.text:
Yes — gladly. Two things I need from you:

1. Who should attend — all five TAs (Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana)?
2. How long should it run, and any day/time preference or topic?

Meanwhile I'm asking the TAs for their availability next week so I can pick a slot that works for everyone (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00).

All five TAs, please — Sarah, John, Priya, Diego and Hana. An hour is enough, and a slot that works for everyone next week is fine by me, any day except Thursday afternoon. No fixed topic yet; I'll bring a short agenda on course logistics, assignments and grading.

Availability is in from all five TAs. Two things stand out:

1. Every TA is only free in **30-minute gaps** next week (their Thu and Fri are fully booked).
2. Your own calendar has no free hour either — the largest gaps in your week are 30 minutes.

So an hour won't fit without moving commitments. The options:

- **30 minutes, nothing to move:** Tue 24 Nov **15:00–15:30** or Wed 25 Nov **10:00–10:30** — all five TAs and your calendar are free in both.
- **A full hour:** Wed 25 Nov **12:30–13:30** or **13:00–14:00** — this would need you to shift Wednesday's Research meeting and Hana to move one block (she's the only one not free Wednesday afternoon; John, Sarah, Priya and Diego are free 13:00–13:30).

Which do you prefer — the clean 30 minutes, or shall I try to negotiate the hour?

Let's take the clean 30 minutes — Tuesday 24 November, 15:00–15:30. No need to move anyone's commitments. Please send the invitation to all five TAs and put it on my calendar; I'll keep to the half hour and follow up anything longer by e-mail.

Small correction to the hour option, to be precise: the only way to an hour on Wed 25 Nov is **13:00–14:00**, and it needs more than I said — you'd shift Guest lecture prep (13:30–14:30), and Sarah, Priya, Diego and John would each have to stretch past their 13:00–13:30 gap; Hana has no Wednesday afternoon at all. No hour next week exists without several moves like that.

My recommendation: the 30-minute slot that needs nothing moved — **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30** (or Wed 10:00–10:30 if you prefer the morning).
Noted, and no change: Tuesday 24 November, 15:00–15:30 it is. Thanks for checking the hour option — I'd rather not shuffle that many things for a staff meeting. Please go ahead with the invitations.

Done ✅

- **Booked on your calendar:** Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30 — CSE455 staff meeting (all TAs), logged in `CALENDAR.md` as BOOKED for Sarah, John, Priya, Diego and Hana.
- **Invitations sent** to all five TAs with the time, length and the agenda topics (course logistics, assignments, grading). Sarah has already confirmed and booked it.

I'll tell you when the rest confirm.
Great, thank you. Keep me posted on the remaining confirmations.

All five confirmed ✅ — Sarah, John, Priya, Diego and Hana have each booked **Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30** and will be there. Your calendar and `CALENDAR.md` are up to date. Nothing outstanding on my side.
Perfect — thanks for handling it so quickly. Nothing more from me.
Happy to help — enjoy the meeting. I'm here if anything else comes up.
